description: Mobile crossbow skirmisher - builds into a charged Heartseeking Bolt and survives on avoidance rather than armour.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_witch-hunter__boltslinger.txt and the boltslinger spec tree in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/witch-hunter.json. CoA calls this 'an Outlaw/Survival hybrid built on real tools... a burst-window rogue crossed with a kiting hunter', and the tree follows its stat priority (Hit > Expertise > Agility > Armor Penetration > Crit > Haste) by spending real points on hit rating, Agility-to-ranged-AP and armour penetration rather than on raw attack power. Expertise has no key in this engine at all, which is the one priority entry nothing here can serve.

nodes.name: Rapid Reload
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your ranged haste by 8%.' ranged_haste is dead - the engine has one haste stat - so it is plain haste at the rate every shipped tree uses.

nodes.name: Mechanized Crossbows
nodes.description: Grants ranged attack power equal to 3% of your Agility per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your ranged attack power by 10% and the range of your ranged abilities by 5 yds.' A flat ranged_attack_power grant is dead - the stat is computed from Agility and Strength in _recalculate_derived_stats and never reads the bonus pool - so this is a real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion off the spec's own primary stat ('Agility (RAP/crit/dodge)'). Range is not modelled.

nodes.name: Night Stalker
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.' Pulled into this tree because the spec's stat priority says 'Critical Strike (Brimming Hatred/Lucky Shot both key off crits for rage and armor-shred)'.

nodes.name: My Trusty Arbalest
nodes.description: Reduces the Focus cost of your abilities by 2% and grants 1 hit rating per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Rage cost of Witchbane and Shadowblast by -10% and increases your chance to hit by 2%.' There is no two-ability cost key, only per-ability and global, so it discounts the whole book at a smaller rate. Hit leads this spec's stat priority.

nodes.name: Heartless
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Physical ranged critical damage by 15%.' No ranged-only crit damage key exists.

nodes.name: Enchanted Bolts
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 3% and your armor penetration by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Magic damage dealt by 5% and your Armor penetration by 10%.' Both halves are real: armor_penetration_pct is PERCENT POINTS (divided by 100 in _recalculate_derived_stats) and is finally consumed in take_damage's physical branch.

nodes.name: Crossbow Expert
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Witchbane by 5% and Shadowblast by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Shadowblast by 10% and Witchbane by 5%.' ability_<id>_damage keys are built by string interpolation in abilities.py - a literal grep calls them dead, which is why 48 of them were once reported so.

nodes.name: Brimming Hatred
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore 10 Focus, no more than once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Your critical strikes now generate 10 Rage. Can only occur every 3 sec.' CoA's Rage is Frontier's Focus for this class (module docstring), and grant_resource is a real proc payload that goes through the same gain_resource every builder ability uses. One point, because a proc's numbers do not scale with ranks.

nodes.name: One Shot
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Heartseeking Bolt by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Heartseeking Bolt by 20%.' ability_<id>_crit is percentage points, the same unit as crit_chance_physical.

nodes.name: Silver Bolts
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Heartseeking Bolt and Damnation by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Heartseeking Bolt and Damnation is increased by 15%, doubled against Undead or Demons or enemies affected by Shadow Trap.' No creature-type or debuff-conditional damage hook, so the flat half only.

nodes.name: Strafing Shot
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your damage-over-time effects by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with ranged abilities now spread Tormentor to a nearby enemy.' Spreading a DoT on crit has no engine shape (a proc can apply a NEW effect but not copy an existing one to another target), so the node pays out as DoT damage instead - Tormentor and Witchbane are both DoTs, which is what the spread was worth.

nodes.name: Bane of Witches
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Heartseeking Bolt now increases your Physical damage dealt by 10% for 8 seconds.' A self-buff-on-cast proc would need an apply_effect keyed to one ability; the rotation keeps Heartseeking Bolt on cooldown anyway, so this is the passive version of the same number.

nodes.name: Arbalest Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Witchbane by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each subsequent shot of a Witchbane cast deals 15% more damage, up to a maximum of 150%.' A ramping channel is not expressible; the average is.

nodes.name: Resourceful Pursuit
nodes.description: Reduces the Focus cost of Tormentor by 3 and Damnation by 3 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Rage cost of Tormentor and Damnation by -20%.' ability_<id>_cost is a FLAT reduction applied before the percentage one, so 3 a rank off a 25 and a 45 cost lands near CoA's 20%.

nodes.name: Relentless
nodes.description: Increases the damage your abilities deal to additional targets by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Allows Witchbane to hit an additional nearby enemy.' Adding a target to a specific ability is not a talent shape - max_targets is authored on the ability - so the node raises AoE damage. NOTE aoe_damage is only read when target_type is 'enemy_aoe', which is why every AoE ability in this class uses that rather than the is_aoe field, which nothing reads.

nodes.name: Escape Artist
nodes.description: Daring Escape lasts 1 turn longer and Vault's cooldown is reduced by 1 turn.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Daring Escape now resets the cooldown of Vault and generates 10 Rage.' A cooldown RESET from one cast has no talent shape, so the reset becomes a flat cooldown reduction and the escape window gets longer.

nodes.name: Evasive
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Twilight Frenzy now grants you -20% reduced damage taken while active.' Conditioning it on one ability being up is not expressible, so it is passive and much smaller.

nodes.name: Crossbow Frenzy
nodes.description: Increases your chance to dodge by 1% and your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While Twilight Frenzy is active, your movement speed is now increased by 40%.' Movement speed is not modelled; what it bought this spec was not being hit, so the node carries dodge.

nodes.name: Neverending Pursuit
nodes.description: Your critical strikes with Damnation restore 40 Focus.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critically striking with Damnation now refunds 40 Rage.' ability_filter narrows a proc to named abilities - a real payload key, read off the authored trees - so this is CoA's node exactly, Focus for Rage.

nodes.name: Contract Killing
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases damage dealt against enemies above 75% health and below 35% health by 15%.' There is no health-banded damage key (low_health_* reads the CASTER's health, not the target's), so it is flat.

nodes.name: Heavy Crossbows
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Darkslayer by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Darkslayer by 50%, but increases its cast time by 0.5 sec. Your Heartseeking Bolt and Darkslayer now have a 25% chance to strike an additional time.' Cast time does not exist in a turn engine, so the drawback is gone and the bonus is proportionally smaller.

nodes.name: Dead and Gone
nodes.description: Pavise lasts 1 turn longer and its cooldown is reduced by 2 turns per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Pavise now lasts 2 additional sec and has a -30 sec reduced cooldown.'

nodes.name: Bounty Hunter
nodes.description: You have been building to one shot this whole time, and it lands where you meant it to. +30% Heartseeking Bolt damage and +15% physical critical damage.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Casting Darkslayer or Witchbane now applies a stack of Bounty Hunter to you for 8 seconds, which can be consumed by casting Heartseeking Bolt to deal an additional ranged AP Physical damage, stacking 2 times.' A build-and-consume stack counter has no engine shape, so the two stacks' worth of bonus is baked into Heartseeking Bolt directly.
